generated_asset_minimum_contract.PIC4_alpha: Every pixel255, including dark/black space; no transparency.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.logos_alpha: RGBA with a genuine alpha channel; unassociated/straight alpha; transparent background and glyph counters; no opaque rectangle/checkerboard/matte. Source has binary alpha; candidate may use bounded soft coverage for high-resolution edges, with independently rendered alpha.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.minimum_support_bound: For registration-preserving pilot, alpha must be zero outside the source opaque bbox scaled4x (provided for each sprite). Retain internal counters/negative space and original silhouette; any intended silhouette expansion requires review. This bbox bound alone does not establish fidelity.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.not_required: Do not force the generated alpha to a nearest-neighbor copy of the original1x mask; that would retain1x stair-step geometry. Preserve source mask as verification reference, not authored art.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.transparent_RGB: Prefer zero RGB where alpha0 to avoid hidden matte/color fringe; alpha, not RGB, determines support.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.palette_and_identity: True-color generated RGB need not be quantized to256 colors. Preserve original red/white planet, dark space, sculpted gold Tyrian lettering, and gold2000/trademark; palette roles and timings remain behavior contracts.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.foreground: Never bake or regenerate menu/version/cursor. Both logos extend into y>=104 after settling; draw native UI over them rather than applying a rectangular menu exclusion mask.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.lease: Artwork selection must be explicitly titleScreen/context-bound, with source/asset validation. Do not enable it globally from PIC4/table3/id coincidence. No renderer activation authorized by this audit.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.missing_invalid_resources: Preserve classic output and original input/timing on missing or invalid asset; no partial stale logo/background cache.
generated_asset_minimum_contract.required_review_states: initial, all29 movement positions, settled/restart, art-only fade0..239, UI-only fade240..255, version/shadow, live menu selection/cursor and submenu return; this audit supplies static contracts, not runtime validation.
